friendly_name: troupe configuration: remote includes and a schema
purpose_context: Step 7 adds the Remote includes and schema contract section. Teams share configuration by including it from a URL; troupe fetches it on load, refuses to change values that come from it and tells the user which include line to change instead. A JSON Schema in .troupe/troupe.schema.json describes the configuration: the loaded configuration must validate against it, settings marked format uri and values tagged !literal are taken literally rather than as includes, and set writes include-looking strings as literals unless --include is given.
purpose_tldr: Configuration can include shared team settings from https:// URLs, read-only to troupe, and a JSON Schema describes the configuration so URL settings are never mistaken for includes.
